newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ISRAEL, April 15 - Haifa - Three vessels due, 1-2 days delay. Loading/discharging at berth 3 general cargo, 4 bulk, 3 containers, 1 tanker. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge 1 general cargo, 1 bulk, 2 containers, 1 under repair/dry-dock, 1 awaiting orders. Ashdod - Two to three days delay. Loading/discharging at berth, 10 general cargo, 2 bulk, 2 containers, 1 passenger. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 3 bulk, 2 containers, 1 tanker. 2 Awaiting orders. Eilat - Loading/discharging at berth, 1 car carrier, 2 passenger vessels. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge 1 general cargo, 1 container, 1 passenger, 1 tanker.

MOZAMBIQUE, April 14 - Nacala - Working normally, first come, first served. No restriction on berthing and sailing at night. Draft restriction 9.5m at general cargo berths, 14m at container berths. One tug. Beira - General cargo berths working normally, 24 hour berthing/sailing for vessels up to 140 metres loa. Some restriction for larger vessels subject to arrangement with port captain. Max. draft for 24 hour navigation 7.5 m, 2 tugs. General access channel 2 waverider buoys deployed in approach channel. Each buoy approx 1 metre diameter, flashing orange light, five one second flashes every 26 seconds. Maputo - Berthing/sailing delays 24 hours for vessels up to 120 metres loa. Some restrictions for larger vessels, subject to arrangement with port captain. All berths fluid. Draft restriction in channel 9 m less 0.5m plus rise of tide. Max draft 4 hour navigation 9m.
NAMIBIA, April 14 - Walvis Bay - Working normally.

SOUTH AFRICA, April 14 - Richard's Bay - General cargo berths - Working normally. No major delays. Bulk import berths - Berth 701 empty until 17/4. Bulk export berths - Normal. No major delays. Bulk coal berths - 4 Vessels alongside, 4 anchored, 1 due 15/4, 14 due by 21/4. Berthing delays approx 24 hours. Durban - Container terminal up to 48 hours delay for some vessels, others berth on arrival. Point/New Pier/Maydon Wharf berths - General cargo working normally. Bunker supplies fluid but could change due to bunching of vessels.

East London - General cargo/combi terminal/tanker berths - Busy but no delays. 1 tanker expected daily. Port Elizabeth - Two vessels in port. No delays on general, fruit or tanker berths. Ore berth - 4 Vessels due, 8 hours delay for one of the vessels. 18/4 Container berths - 2 berths, 2 gantries available, 8 vessels due. No berthing delays but vessels will have extended port stays. Cape Town - Breakbulk (general cargo) - Vessel working on arrival, 2 due. Fruit berths - Fully occupied. Container terminal - Vessels berthing and working on arrival. No delays on bunker berths. Dry-docks and repair quay - Fully occupied and booking essential. Saldanha bay - Working normally.

TUNISIA, April 12 - Sousse - Two vessels in port of which 1 discharging woodpulp, 1 loading bulk cargo. No vessels awaiting orders. No waiting time. Sfax - Four vessels operating of which 1 each discharging bulk wheat, general cargo, 1 each loading bulk olive oil, bulk tsp. Tunis - Five vessels in port of which 1 discharging general cargo, 3 awaiting instructions, 1 discharging steel. Rades - Five in port of which 1 loading oranges, 3 ro-o, 1 loading marble blocks. Goulette - North side - 3 Vessels of which 1 discharging maize, 1 passenger, 1 general cargo. 1 In roads. April 14 - Bizerta - Three vessels in port of which 1 discharging sugar, 1 discharging clay, 1 loading cement. No berthing delays or congestion. Zarzis - No vessels in port.

UNITED ARAB EMIRATES, April 12 - Dubai - Containers - 20 Vessels due. No delays expected. 4 Vessels loading at berth. General cargo - 11 Vessels due. No delays expected, 1 vessel discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 vessel under repair/laid up. Tankers - 3 Vessels due. No delays expected, 2 loading at berth, 9 under repair/laid up, 3 awaiting orders.

YEMEN, April 13 - Hodeidah - Vessels berthed, 2 bulk wheat, 1 container, 1 flour, 1 corn/soybean. 2 Flour vessels awaiting berth at anchorage. Berthing delays, reefers 24 hours, general cargo 2-3 days, bagged cargo 4-5 days, bulk wheat/corn 7 days. No delays for containers. April 15 - Hodeidah - Berths 1, 2, 4, 5, 7 are occupied. All other berths vacant. 6 Vessels longside of which 2 flour, 1 rice/general cargo, 2 bulk wheat, 1 corn. 3 vessels anchored of which 1 bulk wheat, 1 container, 1 passenger. Berthing waiting time up to 1 day for general cargo, containers up to 2 days for bagged cargo, up to 6 days for bulk. Mokha - No vessels in port. Due to Eid Al-Adha from 16/4-21/4, port activities as well as stevedoring will be closed on 17/4 and 18/4. Any operation carried out during the holidays will be at 100 percent overtime.
